subject: ddl: load table ranges from PD instead of region cache (#54598)
summary: Replaces backfill range splitting from region-cache-based `SplitRegionRanges` to PD-backed `RegionCache.BatchLoadRegionsWithKeyRange`, adds `validateAndFillRanges` + unit tests, and updates call sites. Checked later history on `upstream/master`; range validation was further tightened later (e.g. 75695928b9), leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues attributable to this change.
